claim_boundary: Experimental compatibility work only. No invocation, payment, settlement verification, live catalog connection, production interoperability, or partnership is established. All imported records are vendor-supplied and unverified.

price_precision_note: Vendor confirmed price_per_call is unqualified numeric at the storage layer; no rounding or rejection rule exists. The importer preserves the exact decimal as a string; 0.015 USD is never converted to integer cents.
